title: Ozi Queue Phase 3: auto-chain dispatch + minimal context mode
description: Implement auto-chain: after completing a work item, automatically load next ready item with minimal context (~15-20k tokens instead of full ~46k wakeup). Add implementation_notes + uat_recording fields to track schema. Add Closeout Step 10: update queue state, archive completed lug, auto-prepare next item.

perceive.current_state: Each job requires a full wakeup (~46k tokens). No auto-chain between work items. Track schema has no implementation_notes or uat_recording fields. Closeout has no queue state update step.
evidence: wai.md wakeup loads ~46k tokens per session
track.jsonl has event/note fields but no implementation_notes/uat_recording
wai-closeout.md has no queue state update step
files: templates/commands/wai.md (auto-chain trigger in Step 9 after item completion)

steps: 1. Define minimal context load: WAI-State.json (identity only) + target lug + last 2 track turns
2. Add auto-chain trigger to wai.md: when Work [A]uto selected, set auto_chain=true in session state
3. Add implementation_notes and uat_recording fields to track.jsonl turn schema (wai-reference.md)
4. Add Closeout Step 10 to wai-closeout.md: mark item done in _work_queue, auto-load next if auto_chain=true
5. Test: manually chain two items and verify context stays minimal

done_when: wai-closeout.md has Step 10 that updates _work_queue item status
track.jsonl entries from auto-chain sessions have implementation_notes field
Minimal context mode documented in wai-reference.md with token estimate

acceptance_criteria: Auto-chain mode documented and triggerable via wakeup Step 9
Closeout Step 10 marks queue items done and prepares next
Minimal context load defined: WAI-State identity + lug + 2 track turns
Track schema updated with implementation_notes + uat_recording
